s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Shaft Nut LH (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Set the SST aligned with the groove of the rear drive shaft assembly LH, and using a hammer, unstake the rear axle shaft nut.

item.ptxt: Set SST in the groove with its flat surface facing up.
Do not grind the tip of the SST with a grinder or equivalent.
When removing the rear axle shaft nut, completely unstake it.
Do not damage the threads of the drive shaft assembly.

s2.ptxt: Using a socket wrench (30mm), remove the rear axle shaft nut.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Skid Control Sensor Wire (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver, disengage the claw of the connector and disconnect the skid control sensor wire connector.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Speed Sensor Rear LH (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the speed sensor connector.
Remove the grommet and pull it out toward the outside of the vehicle.

atten3.ptxt: Do not pull out the sensor wire harness by grasping it.

s2.ptxt: Remove bolt A and disconnect sensor clamp No.3 from the body.
Remove bolt B and disconnect sensor clamp No.2 from the trailing arm bracket.
Disconnect sensor clamp No.1 from the slotted hole of the trailing arm.
Remove bolt C and the speed sensor RR LH.
Remove the parking brake lever protector from the parking brake cable assembly No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Parking Brake Cable Assembly NO.3

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the cable end from the operating lever of the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.
Using an offset wrench (14mm), disconnect parking brake cable assembly No.3 from the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

atten4.ptxt: Insert the offset wrench all the way into the clip as shown in the illustration, flex the clip, and pull parking brake cable assembly No.3 out of the guide of the rear disc brake cylinder assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and separate the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the caliper with wire or equivalent.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Disc Brake Caliper Assembly LH (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the rear disc brake caliper assembly LH.

atten3.ptxt: Suspend the caliper with wire or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on the disc and axle hub, and remove the disc.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly LH (Drive Type FF)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and remove the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Axle Hub & Bearing Assembly LH (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and disconnect the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.
While lightly tapping the end of the rear drive shaft with a plastic hammer, remove the rear axle hub & bearing assembly LH from the rear axle carrier.

atten4.ptxt: If the engagement is tight, tap the end of the drive shaft using a brass bar and hammer.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Height Control Sensor Sub-assembly Rear

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector and disengage the clamp.
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the height control sensor assembly (rear).

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the nut of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH (rear axle carrier LH side).
Install SST to the stud bolt of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1LH.

atten3.ptxt: Install SST so that it is aligned with the top end of the stud bolt of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, separate the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH from the rear axle carrier LH.

item.ptxt: To prevent SST from falling, be sure to tie it to the rear axle carrier LH with a string so that the string does not slacken.
Install the SST so that A and B of the SST are parallel.
Be sure to apply the wrench at the position shown in the illustration.
Do not damage the ball joint boot of the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and remove the rear suspension arm assembly No.1 LH from the rear suspension member.

atten3.ptxt: Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.

s2.ptxt: Loosen the 2 bolts of the trailing arm assembly rear.

atten3.ptxt: Only loosen the bolts; do not remove them.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Rear Suspension Arm Assembly NO.2 LH

s2.ptxt: Loosen the bolt and nut of the rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH.

item.ptxt: Only loosen the bolt and nut; do not remove them.
Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and nut, and disconnect the upper control arm assembly rear LH from the rear axle carrier.

item.ptxt: Hold the nut and loosen the bolt.
Suspend the rear drive shaft assembly LH with wire or equivalent.
Do not damage the drive shaft outboard joint boot.

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolts and nuts, and remove the rear axle carrier from the trailing arm assembly rear and rear suspension arm assembly No.2 LH.
